# Terrain

`cinnabar:extension/terrain@0.1.0`

Bounded local terrain reads. The queries a callback reads become its subscriptions, which the
client samples before later frames, so a new query reads `pending` first. A deferred callback
keeps its subscriptions. Unknown terrain is never reported as air.

**Grants:** `terrain`.

<a id="type-region"></a>

### `region`

Cell `((x * size-z) + z) * size-y + y`, relative to the minimum, has layer `l` at slot
`l * cells + cell`. Shapes are block-local, with native position offsets applied.

```wit
record region {
    stamp: stamp,
    chunks: list<chunk-revision>,
    layer-count: u8,
    loaded: list<u64>,
    states: list<u16>,
    palette: list<block-state>,
    shape-offsets: list<u32>,
    shape-boxes: list<f64>,
    overrides: list<shape-override>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stamp` | `stamp` |  |
| `chunks` | `list<chunk-revision>` | Every column read, including those consulted for neighbour or actor geometry. |
| `layer-count` | `u8` |  |
| `loaded` | `list<u64>` | Bit `cell % 64` of word `cell / 64` is set for known cells. |
| `states` | `list<u16>` | Palette index per slot; 65535 is no layer, never air. |
| `palette` | `list<block-state>` |  |
| `shape-offsets` | `list<u32>` | Shape `s` is boxes `shape-offsets[s]` to `shape-offsets[s + 1]`. |
| `shape-boxes` | `list<f64>` | Six values per box: minimum then maximum x, y and z. |
| `overrides` | `list<shape-override>` | Sorted by slot. |

Types: [`block-state`](terrain.md#type-block-state), [`chunk-revision`](terrain.md#type-chunk-revision), [`shape-override`](terrain.md#type-shape-override), [`stamp`](terrain.md#type-stamp).

## Functions

<a id="read-region"></a>

### `read-region`

```wit
read-region: func(query: region-query, after: option<stamp>) -> result<read-result, read-error>;
```

Requires terrain authority and a gameplay frame; the query lies within
`MAX_TERRAIN_DISTANCE` blocks of the player's feet on each axis. Pass the stamp last received
for this query to skip unchanged data. Limits are `mod-api`'s `MAX_TERRAIN_*` constants.

Types: [`read-error`](terrain.md#type-read-error), [`read-result`](terrain.md#type-read-result), [`region-query`](terrain.md#type-region-query), [`stamp`](terrain.md#type-stamp).

<a id="find-blocks"></a>

### `find-blocks`

```wit
find-blocks: func(identifiers: list<string>, range: f32, limit: u32) -> result<list<position>, read-error>;
```

Positions of loaded blocks whose identifier matches one of 1 to
`MAX_FOUND_BLOCK_IDENTIFIERS` namespaced names, nearest first, within `range` blocks of
the player's feet (1 to `MAX_TERRAIN_DISTANCE`) and at most `limit` results (1 to
`MAX_FOUND_BLOCKS`). Like a region query, a search becomes a subscription that the client
scans incrementally between frames, so a new search returns none and results fill in as
loaded terrain is scanned. Searches and region queries share `MAX_TERRAIN_QUERIES` and
the callback's terrain call budget. Requires terrain authority and a gameplay frame.

Types: [`position`](terrain.md#type-position), [`read-error`](terrain.md#type-read-error).
